A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CapsIE research. All 15 pages of v1.pdf and 17 pages of v2.pdf, including figures, equations, tables and Appendices A–C, support comparison.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original CapsIE experiments on 3DIEBench, including classification, rotation and colour prediction, capsule-count sensitivity, and objective ablations.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains those original experiments and adds predictor-retrieval results in Section 4.3 and Table 3.

M1.justification: Section 3.1 changes the transformation-conditioning component's description from an MLP to a linear projector. Both versions reference the same SIE predictor and retain the architecture schematic and loss equations. The PDFs do not establish whether this corrects the description or changes the component.

E1.justification: Section 4.3 adds target-view retrieval using predicted embeddings, extending evaluation beyond classification and rotation/colour regression. The underlying 3DIEBench dataset, object population and domain remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 add SIE to the first-intermediate-embedding comparisons. New Table 3 includes an Only Equivariance comparator alongside EquiMod and SIE. The earlier appendix baseline roster is retained.

E3.justification: The new retrieval evaluation introduces PRE, MRR, H@1 and H@5, with training/validation evaluations and distinct PRE source–retrieval pools. Existing pretraining budgets and downstream classification/regression protocols are unchanged.

E4.justification: The capsule-count sensitivity tests, rotation-versus-colour objective ablation, and Appendix C analyses are retained. The original ablation Table 3 becomes Table 4 with identical values. The added retrieval table supplies benchmark evidence rather than a new ablation or robustness test.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or formal significance tests. The existing training curves are retained, and the new results use the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: New Table 3 reports validation PRE of 0.21 for CapsIE versus 0.29 for SIE, and validation MRR of 0.47 versus 0.41. Tables 1–2 add SIE intermediate-embedding scores. Existing matched table values remain unchanged; the conclusion corrects a claimed 0.2 R² gain to 0.02.

T1.justification: The group-equivariance assumptions, routing equations and objectives in Equations 1–8 are unchanged. Appendix B.3 explains established retrieval metrics and their quaternion-distance formula without introducing a new theoretical result or formal property. The latent-symbol correction is notational.

C1.justification: The abstract narrows its state-of-the-art claim to comparison with prior equivariant SSL methods. The conclusion reduces the claimed supervised rotation advantage from 0.2 to 0.02 R². The capsule-projector and entropy-objective contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: New Section 4.3 interprets retrieval gains under a shared predictor as evidence for the capsule projector's contribution to equivariance, and compares H@1 against 0.02 chance performance. Existing limitations concerning scaling and known transformation parameters are retained.

D1.justification: Appendix B.3 documents predicted-embedding retrieval, same-object candidate restrictions for ranking metrics, and PRE computation. Section 3.1 revises the hypernetwork description. Existing hyperparameters, hardware, training times and code/data access links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The 33 cited works and Section 6 discussion are retained. The abstract modestly narrows competitive positioning by explicitly framing its state-of-the-art claim relative to prior equivariant SSL methods.

P1.justification: v2 adds Sections 4.3 and B.3 and makes localized edits to notation, the variance-regularisation explanation, affiliations and contact information. Most prose and the overall section sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds retrieval Table 3 and expands Tables 1–2 with SIE rows. The old ablation table's heading is corrected from Colour Prediction to Rotation Prediction. All seven figures are retained, with training plots and appendix tables reflowed.

improvement.justification: Direct predictor-retrieval evaluation and SIE intermediate-layer comparisons strengthen the evidence for the capsule projector. The corrected 0.02 R² supervised gain agrees with Table 2's 0.78 versus 0.76 for ResNet-18. These focused additions and corrections improve validation and reporting accuracy, although the hypernetwork description change remains ambiguous.
